caption:
Lulu ground out one last heavy bench rep and felt a twinge at the front of the chest, up towards the armpit.

Heavy reps when you're tired put a lot of load through the chest muscle. A mild strain usually settles with a short break from heavy pressing, gentle movement within comfort, and building the weight back up slowly.

Hybi's plan: restart with 10 wall push-ups and add load over a few weeks. Chest pain with breathlessness or sweating may not be muscular, so call 000.

A pop with bruising, a change in chest shape, or weakness is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
